title: Platinum Reserve Account: Advanced Cash Flow Analytics and Reporting
summary: Covers Platinum Reserve Account features for analytics workspace (configurable inflow/outflow categories/tags and attribution filters), custom liquidity report exports (up to 30 per month, template saving, metadata/category mappings), and API dashboard data access (request via admin settings, min-scope credentials, separate non-prod/prod, rotate and revoke tokens). Also includes data governance guidance: align exports/API with internal retention/privacy policies and validate totals vs the dashboard before stakeholder distribution.
faqs: How do I build consolidated inflow/outflow views in the analytics workspace using categories and tags?
How can I isolate the drivers of variance across periods using attribution filters?
What are the limits and requirements for exporting custom liquidity reports each month (and can I save templates)?
What does API access for dashboard data involve, and how do I request it from administrative settings?
Should I use separate API credentials for non-production vs production, and how often should credentials be rotated?
What data governance checks are required before distributing exported data to stakeholders?
